title: 灵境 · 1v1 对战 UI 多状态稿
scope: 设计预览；未改应用代码。画面数值与15s倒计时为示意，不在此稿确定正式蓄力阈值。
requirements: 双方状态卡镜像：头像在外侧，等级在头像下方且留在卡片内。
名字之后紧跟属性图标，右侧名称组靠右，文字保持正常方向。
血条和怒气条加高、数值内嵌；右侧条形从右向左填充。
回合文案简化为回合2，保留独立倒计时。
移除出战伙伴；场内一对一，右侧仅保留回合记录。
攻击、属性、闪避共三个等大圆形技能按钮；悬停说明分别为打断属性、无法闪避、闪避攻击。
三圆下方显示统一蓄力条；蓄满后在其左侧出现更大的金色大招圆形按钮。
baseGenerationPrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE high-fidelity full desktop app UI design, 1536x1024 landscape proportions, for the existing Chinese anime companion game 灵境. Input image is STYLE AND CHARACTER REFERENCE ONLY; its old HUD, party list and rectangular skill buttons are WRONG and MUST be rebuilt. Keep the ivory/ice-blue sidebar, navy Chinese sans-serif, four-point star logo, beautiful blue night lantern courtyard and cute 2D deer 青芽 versus orange Shiba 焰柴. Do not copy the old controls or old HUD layout.

STATE 1: NEUTRAL / CHARGING, no hovered button, no tooltip. One-versus-one only.

Critical HUD reconstruction: create TWO IDENTICAL-SIZE WHITE STATUS PANELS arranged as PERFECTLY MIRRORED COUNTERPARTS around the battlefield center. Mirror the WHOLE STRUCTURE, not just the portrait: left outer portrait-and-level column, left text/bar column pointing inward; right text/bar column pointing inward, right outer portrait-and-level column. All card edges, portrait sizes, thick bar widths and paddings match. Left avatar looks RIGHT; right Shiba avatar looks LEFT. Every portrait is entirely INSIDE its panel. Each portrait has "Lv.01" centered immediately BELOW it, also fully INSIDE the card with bottom padding. NO level text beside the name. Left name is "青芽" followed immediately by a small leaf element icon. Right name is "焰柴" followed immediately by a small fire icon, in normal Chinese reading order; right name-plus-icon group is right aligned toward its portrait. NO element icon before the name. Keep every digit and Chinese glyph normally readable.

Mirror HP/rage FILL DIRECTION and icon placement too: the LEFT panel bars fill from LEFT toward the center; the RIGHT panel bars fill from RIGHT toward the center, leaving the EMPTY part of each right bar visibly on the LEFT. Put heart/energy icons at the outer ends of bars: LEFT bar icons on LEFT; RIGHT bar icons on RIGHT. Numeric values are centered INSIDE tall bars. HP about28px tall mint; energy about24px tall blue/amber. Player HP96/120, energy36/100; enemy HP82/120, energy56/100. Thus right HP empty left32%, filled right68%; right energy empty left44%, filled right56%. This reversed fill is mandatory and visibly proves the mirror.

Approximate balanced HUD grid in the central arena: left card41%, timer column18%, right card41%; identical card width/height. The center column aligns to the middle of the battle ARENA, not the whole app. Compact top round pill reads EXACTLY "回合 2", nothing longer. Below: blue circular countdown clock with large "15s". No "第", no explanatory slogan, no long round text. Keep names, antlers and avatars clear.

Remove the ENTIRE 出战伙伴 panel, party thumbnails, add-partner button, party counts and all roster UI. The right sidebar now contains ONLY "回合记录" with a few simple compact action rows and a bottom "离开对战" control. The arena contains exactly one deer facing right and exactly one Shiba facing left; NO extra combatants.

Completely replace the bottom rectangular skill cards with THREE MATCHING CIRCULAR SKILL BUTTONS in a single clean row. All THREE circles have the SAME diameter ~86px, identical blue/ice rim, pale blue fill and matching line-icon style. Circle1 sword icon with label "攻击" directly below; circle2 leaf/element icon label "属性"; circle3 curved dodge-motion icon label "闪避". Use only these short labels, no persistent descriptions. No cards behind individual buttons. No rectangular skill buttons, no FOUR regular circles. Below the group of these THREE circles is ONE slim continuous charge-progress bar, aligned to the width of the three-circle group, small text "蓄力 36%". Fill it36%. Keep generous spacing between circles, labels and bar.
When not fully charged there is NO ultimate circle, NO grey placeholder, NO locked fourth skill, and NO ultimate card anywhere. Reserve tasteful empty space LEFT of the three-circle group for a larger golden ultimate circle that appears in another state, but do not draw anything in that space now.
No hover tooltip in this state. All circles neutral with equal styling. Do not add costs, keybinds, tutorial text or controls the user did not request.

Preserve elegant original visual style; this is an actual polished desktop game screen, no device frame, no perspective, no collage, no annotations or watermark. Full screen and bottom bar visible. Exact mirror structure including right-to-left enemy bar fills, level below portrait inside card, post-name element icons, no party list, three equal circular buttons and a shared charge bar are the essential requirements.

states.name: 蓄力中
states.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Precise edit of this exact neutral 1v1 battle UI. Keep EVERYTHING unchanged, including character art, layout, equal mirrored HUD cards, avatar levels, right-to-left enemy bar fills, "回合 2" pill, "15s" timer, three equal blue circular skills and36% shared charge bar. No new text or objects.

Fix exactly ONE small error: in the RIGHT enemy card, the flame element icon is currently BEFORE the name 焰柴. REMOVE the flame from its current position on the LEFT of the name and put the SAME flame immediately AFTER the name, on its RIGHT, with a small6px gap. The right name row must read left-to-right exactly "焰柴 [small flame icon]". Put this name+flame group above the bars, right aligned with the bar column and just before the portrait. Keep the flame outside the portrait and within the card; do not overlap any letters. The LEFT name row already correctly reads "青芽 [leaf icon]" and must remain unchanged. Both element icons must FOLLOW the name in ordinary reading order. No element icon before either name.

Everything else stays identical. Do not alter the perfectly mirrored bar fills. Do not introduce a tooltip or gold ultimate circle in this neutral charging state. Full screenshot, same aspect and resolution, no crop.

states.name: 大招就绪
states.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Edit this EXACT neutral 1v1 灵境 battle screen to show STATE 5: ULTIMATE READY / FULL CHARGE. Preserve the entire scene, app sidebar, character art and poses, all spacing, the RIGHT action-log-only panel, and perfectly mirrored top HUD. Keep portrait levels BELOW portraits INSIDE both cards; element icons AFTER names ("青芽 [leaf]" and "焰柴 [flame]"); keep enemy bars filling from RIGHT to LEFT, numbers inside, readable. Keep compact "回合 2" and15s countdown.

ONLY THREE CHANGES:
1. Fully fill the ONE shared charge-progress bar BELOW the three basic skill circles. Turn that bar rich luminous gold with delicate sparkling accents and small readable label EXACTLY "蓄力 100%". Keep the bar in the same position and same width, under ONLY the three blue circles.
2. Update the player's top energy bar from36/100 to100/100, full fill. HP96/120 unchanged. Enemy HP82/120 and energy56/100 unchanged.
3. Add ONE NEW, CLEARLY LARGER GOLDEN CIRCULAR ULTIMATE BUTTON immediately to the LEFT of the THREE unchanged basic skill circles. This is a fourth button that appears ONLY now that charge is full. The THREE basic circles labelled 攻击 / 属性 / 闪避 remain EXACTLY the same size, same design, same blue color, same positions and aligned centers; do NOT shrink, remove, recolor or move them.
Place the NEW gold ultimate circle in the existing empty space left of the sword circle, roughly centered x=400,y=840 in this1536x1024 image. Diameter approximately180px, compared with140px for the blue circles, visibly about30% larger. It must fit fully inside the battlefield, separated from the sword circle by clear breathing room, never overlap or enter the navigation sidebar, never cover any character. This gold circle has a sophisticated symmetrical FOUR-POINT CELESTIAL STAR at its center, nested gilded rings, delicate ornate small diamond details, warm amber-white inner glow and a few restrained star particles. An exciting anime-game ultimate icon, ornate and precious, NOT a plain gold recoloring of the sword. Small label "大招" directly below the gold circle. Entire circular silhouette remains readable and larger than the blue ones, not an explosion.
No tooltip and no mouse cursor in this state, no extra locked buttons, no party list, no rectangular skill cards, no tutorials, no added banners. Retain the screenshot composition and aspect ratio. Full frame, no crop, no annotations, no watermark. A viewer must immediately see three SAME-SIZE blue basic skills, plus one LARGER ornate GOLD ultimate circle on their LEFT, with the shared progress bar full.
